FSR_the_sane_choice.title: The Bourbon Rebirth
FSR_the_sane_choice.description:
Iberia has fallen, and with it Spain suffers. Across our land godless socialists and degenerate Nazis run rampant, demolishing our culture under their chaotic regimes. But even in this dark hour, there is hope.

Our forces were able to save some areas from the coup, and troops loyal to the true Spanish Government are mobilizing. Have hope Countrymen, for the Bourbons have come again.

FSR_reestablish_the_comit_de_accin.title: Reestablish the Comité de Acción
FSR_reestablish_the_comit_de_accin.description:
While we may have a government, we need to ensure our King and our movement act as one, in a way that a simple bureaucracy could not accomplish.

To this end, we shall reestablish the Comité de Acción, a group made up of local and regional leaders and led by our Monarch. It shall not replace the government, but shall allow our Kingdom to organically meet the most pressing needs of the people, while avoiding some of the inefficiencies of a civil service.

FSR_the_question_of_unity.title: The Question of Unity
FSR_the_question_of_unity.description:
While in Spain our numbers may be few, our resolve is the strongest as it is carried by the force of our righteousness. Together, no usurper can stand against us!

That being said, standing together is harder than we had initially hoped. Our movement is riddled with fractures, from petty squabbles to lineage disagreements. We must address these distractions immediately.

FSR_sivattes_catalonian_influence.title: Sivatte's Catalonian Influence
FSR_sivattes_catalonian_influence.description:
Mauricio de Sivatte is a man of the old school, even by our standards. A man of strict orthodoxy, or at least his own blend of it, he has been noted as criticizing some of our decisions as we entered the War. While somewhat irritating, he does have an audience and there may be plenty of room to compromise.

We shall reach out to Sivatte and give him a position within our ministries. Doing so will help to unify the forces of tradition in Spain, give us the support of his followers and, thankfully, make him stop his complaining.

FSR_urmenetas_basque_connections.title: Urmeneta's Basque Connections
FSR_urmenetas_basque_connections.description:
Regardless of how distasteful the lust for capital can be, we are certainly no communists. We recognise how expensive wars can be, and we are more capable than simply rejecting it and waging war simply by pointing a gun at our people's back.

A partial solution is personified in Miguel Javier Urmeneta, a man with connections to the Northern financial and business circles. With his support we can gain much needed money for the war effort, and improve capital access for our businesses.

FSR_meet_with_carloctavistas.title: Meet with Carloctavistas
FSR_meet_with_carloctavistas.description:
It is impossible to create consensus without first speaking to the dissenters. The Carloctavistas support a rival claimant to the throne, supporting the sons of Blanca de Borbon instead of honoring the rules of succession.

However, they were supported by the Francoists and a notable number sympathize with them, making their influence currently unignorable. We shall reach out to see what compromises can be made to further unify our movement.

FSR_speak_with_the_aet.title: Speak with the AET
FSR_speak_with_the_aet.description:
Across Europe, universities have been the enemy of tradition and God, often spreading subversive and degenerate ideas through cadres of weak-minded students. However, there is a group in Spanish universities that put God and Javier first in their mind; the Agrupación de Estudiantes Tradicionalistas.

We will strengthen our ties to it and bolster them so that the young may be saved from corrupting influences. We can also better watch them, and make sure they don't begin to deviate from our cause.

They are still students after all.

FSR_celebrate_the_margaritas.title: Celebrate the Margaritas
FSR_celebrate_the_margaritas.description:
The Margaritas are a truly blessed thing that only we could have created in Spain. An organization of women loyal to God and Javier, they advocate for our cause and are a symbol of true traditional femininity in this age of subversion.

While we would not ever use women the way other groups are disgracing them, their sacrifices in the hospitals, their service in the home and their piety at the Church services has been noticed. We shall feature them in a propaganda effort and promote them everywhere we can, so that traditional values may be safeguarded in the home.

FSR_promises_of_continuity.title: Promises of Continuity
FSR_promises_of_continuity.description:
There are those across Spain who claim us to be traitors -that we are no more than common usurpers, wielding little more than a pretender on strings. Even in our territory, our King and his divine right are ridiculed by miscreants.

To remedy this, we shall sponsor a new propaganda campaign to educate both our people and Spain itself that it is in fact all others who are pretenders. Only we represent Spain and its true, ordained administration. Posters, radio and TV broadcasts will make it clear - even if thieves throw a man out of his house, it is he who remains the rightful master.

FSR_rise_requet_rise.title: Rise Requeté Rise
FSR_rise_requet_rise.description:
The Requete, our militia from the days of the Second Republic and the last Civil War, were fierce fighters who struck fear into the hearts of those who rejected their God and their King. Unfortunately their hour has come again.

After years of being integrated into the Spanish, and then Iberian, army we must raise new tercios of soldiers, and do a swift reorganization. No longer a militia, the Requete shall become the foundation of a new Spanish Army.

FSR_new_navarrese_brigades.title: New Navarrese Brigades
FSR_new_navarrese_brigades.description:
Navarre is a rugged area. It has seen difficult fighting before, against both Napoleon's legions and those opposing our Nationalist alliance in the last Civil War. In this war, it has turned against Spain and been stolen by unworthy men, as a brigand steals a wallet.

Such injustices have not gone unnoticed and there remain men from the area, proficient in fighting in such difficult terrain, who remember their true loyalties. We shall organize these exiles into elite units, and offer them a chance to restore God and King to Navarre and Spain.

FSR_autonomous_infantry_battalions.title: Autonomous Infantry Battalions
FSR_autonomous_infantry_battalions.description:
Contrary to what our detractors say, traditionalism does not mean ignorance. The wars of this century have shown us that the key to military victory is limited autonomy and we have taken note. The old ways of war died in the fields of France and Britain as their lethargic armies were destroyed by Germany's dynamic forces.

We shall issue new guidance to our officers encouraging a degree of autonomy, allowing our forces to react faster and more effectively than our enemies will be able to.Through evolution, we shall stand strong.

FSR_azcarragas_marines.title: Azcarraga's Marines
FSR_azcarragas_marines.description:
A loyal member of the former Iberian Navy, José Luis de Azcárraga, has approached us regarding reconstituting the Marine wing of the Navy. He has identified loyal soldiers who were past employed in the Iberian military who are proficient in amphibious warfare.

While we shall not be engaged in fights across seas in the immediate future, such units can ensure river bridgeheads to strike the traitors where they least expect. With such men the armies that stand against us cannot stand.

FSR_experts_of_propaganda.title: Experts of Propaganda
FSR_experts_of_propaganda.description:
Our Spain is a place of culture and art, and one art in which we shall invest is the art of rhetoric. We have identified a score of men who once worked in occupations related to affecting public opinion and attitudes, both in the service of the Government or businesses. We will issue special service exemptions for these individuals on the condition they form a new advisory body in our administration to advise public campaigns.

Such experts can bring our message of piety, tradition and monarchy to a new generation and greatly enhance the effectiveness of our propaganda.

FSR_experts_of_guerrilla.title: Experts of Guerrilla
FSR_experts_of_guerrilla.description:
While the light that God and King brings is present in our territory, there are still many areas of Spain that are kept in the dark by those of the degenerate and godless mindset. We have heard those masses crying out in that darkness, and we shall bring them hope.

We shall invest in new penetrative 'expeditions' into enemy territory, using proficient troops and exiles, to harass enemy units and spread Carlism to local populations. While risky and costly, we shall ensure that the tactics that destroyed Napoleon will destroy Spain's new enemies.

FSR_mobilise_auxiliary_tercios.title: Mobilise Auxiliary Tercios
FSR_mobilise_auxiliary_tercios.description:
The longer the War continues, the more ravenous our army's hunger for men. While there is some general distaste towards further mobilisations, we can soften this by implementing Auxiliary Conscription instead.

Conscripting men to serve behind the lines in the multitude of support roles that are required will also allow more men to be redirected to the frontline without drawing too much of the ire of the commons. Of course there will be those that recognise our ruse, but they should be too small a group to cause too many issues.

FSR_in_the_name_of_the_red_beret.title: In the Name of the Red Beret
FSR_in_the_name_of_the_red_beret.description:
While the icon of God and King should be sufficient, we do recognise those concepts may be too abstract for the many commoners. Therefore, we shall start to focus our military propaganda on the Red Beret of our Requetes.

This will allow all Spaniards to know who fights for them, and across Spain the symbol of the Red Beret will inspire men to give all in the service of their country. The men of our army will know that Beret is a symbol of courage and give them renewed drive to end this War.

FSR_el_fuero_de_guerra.title: El Fuero de Guerra
FSR_el_fuero_de_guerra.description:
So far our economic stances have been a little too reactive to events or inherited from the old Iberian administration. This has led to some confusion and unnecessary red tape, things felt inevitably the most by our brave soldiers. As such, we shall create a comprehensive policy paper outlining a true war economy.

This will allow us not only to improve the strength of our war effort, it will also facilitate the continuing reform of our economy into a truly national, Carlist one.

FSR_economic_pragmatism.title: Economic Pragmatism
FSR_economic_pragmatism.description:
While a national, God-fearing and moral economy is the constant objective of our state, we would be remiss to overlook the simple reality that fundamental economic reforms during a war that has reduced parts of our nation to anarchy may not be the best advised idea.

We shall engage in some minor reforms of course, but we shall stop short of many of our stated goals for the time being and instead prioritize efficiency. This will earn some complaints from our more hardline cadres but such things are regrettably necessary in times of war.

FSR_reestablish_the_sindicatos_libres.title: Reestablish the Sindicatos Libres
FSR_reestablish_the_sindicatos_libres.description:
While the socialist trade unions were dens of subversion and blasphemy, we are far from cruel capitalists. Workers receiving representation is no bad thing, so long as they keep in mind their position.

To this end, we shall create a new national Workers Union, the Sindicatos Libres, which will allow workers a voice with an emphasis on christian morality and calm agreements based on reality, not doctrine. Any socialist agitating members that still remain shall be dealt with, either by prosecution or by an unfortunate 'accident' in the workplace, depending on what looks better on the paperwork.

FSR_decentralize_the_war_industry.title: Decentralize the War Industry
FSR_decentralize_the_war_industry.description:
Industry is a crude beast, and if left unleashed can run havoc over a nation. One only needs to see the degeneracy of America or the lethargy of Japan to see that. We recognise that the best way to restrain this beast is by ensuring righteous men are at the helm who prioritize not capitalistic advancement or individual power but the needs of the State, the King it serves and the God who commands him.

We shall distribute control of vital industries to prominent supporters of our cause, and reduce state control over them. Such men will ensure sound business will maintain the Carlist war effort, while the reduced state interference will avoid creating Spanish zaibatsus.

FSR_break_up_war_strikes.title: Break Up War Strikes
FSR_break_up_war_strikes.description:
We are not blind to the needs of our people, we understand that War brings with it difficult conditions and intense demands that wear them down. However, some dissidents are claiming we go too far and are exploiting the situation to undermine our war effort and aid our enemies with strikes.

This is unacceptable. We shall direct all workplaces to make the wartime prohibition of strikes clear. To any who still transgress, examples will be made where all can see.

FSR_mobilize_the_countryside.title: Mobilize the Countryside
FSR_mobilize_the_countryside.description:
The countryside is a bastion of morality and faith, and so we must take measures to make full use of it. The two priorities are the ever-present need for manpower and the farms which are vital for our food supply.

We shall engage in a recruitment drive, highlighting our need for god-fearing and brave men for the frontlines. We shall couple this with strategic draft exemptions for our farmers as well as investments in the larger farms to ease transporting their goods.

FSR_mobilize_the_cities.title: Mobilize the Cities
FSR_mobilize_the_cities.description:
Our cities hold the key to our industrial output, as well as large amounts of our population. While city dwellers may not be of the same caliber as those who live a more traditional life in the countryside, their sheer number will make them the backbone of our forces. Further the equipment we will need cannot be grown, so the factories of the cities is vital.

We shall run a campaign highlighting the threat the pretenders represent to Spanish society itself in the cities to ensure there will be no shortage of volunteers, while also providing funds for strategic industries with which to improve their production lines.

FSR_mobilize_the_exiles.title: Mobilize the Exiles
FSR_mobilize_the_exiles.description:
Some of our nation's more troublesome sons who refused to reject their King found themselves unwelcome in Spain, even with our presence in the former government. Many of these left and have come into considerable prosperity in other nations. It is time now that we ask them to prove the commitment to which they accepted exile.

We shall reach out to as many sympathetic exiles as possible and ask them to lend support for our economy, however they can. With their support, we shall have the funds we need to create a Spain that will accept them back with open arms.

FSR_the_hunt_for_grafters_and_corrupters.title: The Hunt for Grafters and Corrupters
FSR_the_hunt_for_grafters_and_corrupters.description:
Until recently, we were a shrinking organization being pushed to the fringes of Iberian politics. Now we actively contest to liberate Spain. This has seen a massive and rapid expansion of our organizations and supporters.

We are aware however that such a fast expansion means we cannot be certain of our new brothers and sisters. We shall ensure our security services maintain a close eye on our internal groups so that spies and traitors cannot derail our efforts from within.

FSR_dios_patria_fueros_rey.title: Dios, Patria, Fueros, Rey
FSR_dios_patria_fueros_rey.description:
All of our efforts are to create a God-fearing, righteous and strong Spain. Not for over a century has Spain been so close to such a joyous situation. All the blood, all the sacrifice and the hard decisions. All is so that we can create a state washed in the blood of the lamb, not just the blood of our enemies.

We shall remind our people of this fact. Our King and the Church shall speak, from podium or pulpit, of the piety and values that shall be the base of the new Spain. After so much chaos we shall ensure that our people remember why we fight.
